rules.licensedReferenceFranchises: genre/quality reference only; no copied characters, names, maps, music, models, textures, animation or code
rules.audio: record composer/source, license, sample rate, loop points, loudness and mute/caption behavior
rules.images: record source file, dimensions, format, compression, alpha use and target resolutions
rules.characters: record canonical name, silhouette, palette, rig, animation set, expression set and narrative role
rules.release: no asset reaches APPROVED_FOR_RELEASE without provenance, license and in-game QA evidence
